topic: How does the 45° scan range affect link budget calculations for edge-of-coverage users compared to broadside beams?
consensus_response: The 45° scan range reduces antenna gain, increases beam squint and scan losses, degrading signal quality for edge users. Polarization mismatch further decreases effective antenna gain, while hybrid beamforming and adaptive techniques can mitigate these effects, optimizing link performance.
reference_context: SatCom systems use beamforming to manage capacity and QoS, with techniques like ACM and polarization diversity to adapt to user movement and environmental changes.
